## About This Project

[Quarto](https://quarto.org/) supports creating interactive HTML presentations using [Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/), a powerful framework for building slide decks directly from Markdown. This is particularly useful for academic and technical presentations where you need to include code, equations, and visualizations.

### Key Features

- **Markdown-based slides** — Write content in plain Markdown, Quarto handles the rendering
- **Code highlighting** — Syntax-highlighted code blocks with optional line numbers
- **Themes** — Multiple built-in themes (dark, moon, night, etc.)
- **Transitions** — Smooth slide transitions (slide, fade, convex, zoom)
- **Speaker notes** — Built-in presenter mode with notes
- **LaTeX support** — Render equations natively
